name: Amanda Hanaway
body: I remember the first day I saw you at UVM. I was at least 100 yards away but walking in your direction. I remember seeing someone in baggy jeans and timberland boots, and thinking "finally someone in Vermont with some style". As I got closer and realized it was you, I died laughing. Of course the only other person on campus with any fashion sense grew up right around the corner from me. You were the best couch surfer I’ve ever had and I’m rocking some reggae tunes right now just for you. Gone too soon, my dude. Way too soon.
